description.value: Remote backcountry campground near Elk Lakes in the southern Rockies, with reservations managed by the Alpine Club of Canada; hard trail-in access makes it impractical for a loaded touring bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website returned only BC Parks navigation elements with no park-specific content, so OSM tags serve as the primary evidence source. OSM confirms backcountry=yes, tents=yes, fee=yes, payment:cash=yes, internet_access=no, and sanitary_dump_station=no. The fetched URL corresponds to the general Elk Lakes Park page operated by BC Parks, consistent with the OSM operator tag, but no amenity details for this specific campground were extractable.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the general Elk Lakes Park page rather than a page specific to Lower Elk Lake Campground; no campground-level amenity details were captured.
No address or phone contact information available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks backcountry campground confirmed via OSM tags and the live BC Parks website; useful to touring cyclists seeking wilderness camping in the Kootenays.

wow_evidence: hard trail-in access makes it impractical for a loaded touring bike
